title: The Hobbit
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
summary: A homebody hobbit is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves to win back a mountain from a dragon. Along the way he finds courage he never knew he had.
readIf: You want a classic adventure with a cosy start and a storyteller's voice.
skipIf: You prefer modern pacing or characters with more inner conflict.

pairings.reason: Takes the comfort of good company in a fantasy world and drops the quest entirely.
A more grown-up, detailed fantasy for readers ready to go deeper into the genre.
